nodes.label: graphify hook install (post-commit auto-rebuild)
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit rather than running a background process; only re-runs AST extraction on changed code files, ignoring doc/image changes which still need a manual --update.

nodes.label: graphify claude install (native CLAUDE.md integration)
nodes.rationale: Writes a persistent ## graphify section into the project's CLAUDE.md so Claude Code always checks the graph before answering codebase questions and rebuilds it after code changes, without needing manual /graphify invocation each session.
